item.title: ATHLETE OF THE WEEK: Vivienne Legato (Archbold)
item.description: The female Athlete of the Week is Archbold wrestler Vivienne Legato. item.title: Williams County Under Level 2 Snow Emergency; Fulton County At Level 1
item.description: Williams County is at a Level Two Snow Emergency. Black ice is the primary concern even on main routes. Use extreme caution if you must travel. A Level 1 Snow emergency has been issued for Fulton County – Roads may be hazardous with blowing and drifting snow or icy. Drive very cautiously.
